canonical_serialization: UTF-8 JSON with lexicographically sorted object keys and compact separators

continuity_rules.required_stop_boundary: Independent GLM review after 2-J.9T-D before Batch 2

denied_actions: broader network access than dependency acquisition
permitted_environment_recovery: locate and use a trusted Source Proxy Python environment
use a trusted environment from another Source Proxy worktree with the audit worktree as CWD and first source path
create an isolated .venv-source-proxy in this audit worktree
install declared or pinned test dependencies only into that isolated environment
use verified local caches or the official configured package index only when required
create a pinned rootless test container when a venv is unsuitable
